en: The postcard features a black-and-white photo of uniformed soldiers, likely engineers or pioneers, constructing a temporary bridge over a body of water. The men appear to be from an early 20th-century army, wearing light-colored uniforms and dark hats, standing and sitting on the partially constructed bridge and floating pontoons. The terrain is rural, with a stony shore in the foreground and gently rolling hills in the background. The text is printed in German at the top.
